newsitem.title: USA: Mace Security names Mark Capone as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Mace Security names Mark Capone as CFO.

text.p: Mace Security International Inc said Monday that it has named Mark Capone chief financial officer, treasurer and vice-president, effective September 2.
Capone was previuosly an independent consultant for three years and has also held a senior financial position with International Paper Co.
He succeeds Brian Kelley in the CFO position. No further information was immediately available from the company.

Mace Security is a leading producer of less-lethal defense sprays for the consumer and law enforcement markets as well as chemical munitions and accessories to law enforcement, correctional and military services.
